title: fix(console): Notification Settings is read-only, with its reason, for a caller with no write grant
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35192

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：外部成员（`org_external`）打开 Account 应用的「通知设置」时，页面现在整页只读：所有开关、摘要下拉和免打扰时段都置灰，顶部一行说明原因（已译成全部 11 种内置语言），每个置灰控件都把这行原因作为无障碍描述，且不会发出任何写请求。
- **为什么改**：`external_default` 权限集对 `sys_notification_preference` 没有新建或编辑授权，之前页面照样给出可操作的控件，每次点击都回 403。判断依据是框架自己给当前用户的权限答复（`/me/permissions`，经 `usePermissions()` 读取），页面不看身份名称。
- **风险与回滚**：风险低，只改一个页面的前端呈现；服务端拒绝逻辑与权限集均未改动。没有挂载权限答复的宿主保持原样（可写，由服务端裁决）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：① `NotificationSettingsPage.tsx` 中 `writeGranted` 的取值与 `apply` 里的守卫；② 同文件新增的只读提示 `Alert` 及各控件的 `aria-describedby`；③ `NotificationSettingsPage.test.tsx` 末尾三种身份的新测试。
- **两分钟验证**：在 worktree 的 `ui/` 下运行 `npx vitest run --root . packages/app-shell/src/console/notification-settings/`，预期 2 个测试文件、31 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `NotificationSettingsPage` reads the caller's grant on `sys_notification_preference` through `usePermissions()` (the console's `/me/permissions` answer, the same read `ObjectView`'s personal-view grant uses). A write is a create (no own row yet) or an edit (the person's own row), so the page is read-only when the caller holds neither.
- Read-only means: every switch, the digest select and the quiet-hours Save are disabled, the quiet hours render as text (the field widget's `readonly` face), one visible reason sits at the top of the page (`notificationSettings.readOnly`), and each disabled control points `aria-describedby` at it. `apply` also refuses to send while the grant is missing, so no write leaves the page even if a handler fires (a `change` event still reaches a disabled select).
- The reason is one visible line rather than one tooltip per control: the reason is the same for every control on the page (the `InspectorReadOnlyReason` rationale), and the page already explains its other limits as visible hint lines (`digestNoOff`, `quietHoursNoClear`). Per the claim's Choice line, the nav entry stays: the external member still sees what is in force for them.
- With no permission answer (no provider mounted, or not loaded yet) the page stays writable and the server's refusal decides, as every other console grant read does (`!perms.isLoaded || perms.can(...)`).
- New locale key `notificationSettings.readOnly` in all 11 built-in locales (en, ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

Head `28e8973f5b`. Three persona pins in `NotificationSettingsPage.test.tsx` (new top-level `describe`), each through the real `MePermissionsProvider` over that persona's `/me/permissions` answer, shaped as the default sets serve it:

- `org_external` (`external_default`: no row for the object, no `'*'`): reason shown, cell / digest / Save disabled and described by the reason, quiet hours read as text, the in-force sources still drawn; clicking a cell, changing the digest and clicking Save send no create and no update, and the door is read once.
- member (`member_default`: create + edit on the object) and organization administrator (`organization_admin`'s `'*'` row): no reason, controls enabled, a switch creates the person's own row. These are the controls.

```
npx vitest run --root . --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/console/notification-settings/

os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (two, both red, both restored)</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head (the page is imported from source by relative path, so no build sits between the edit and the run):

1. `writeGranted` forced to `true`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `e7f9c1e8b056` to `11dcab5d0934`; the external-member pin fails (`Tests 1 failed | 14 passed (15)`), the member and admin pins stay green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. The `!writeGranted` guard in `apply` removed: anchor 1 to 0, blob `e7f9c1e8b056` to `fb6e88e32901`; the external-member pin fails on `expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times` (the digest `change`). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A caller holding exactly one of create / edit (no default set does) still sees the page writable; a write of the other kind answers 403 and the page shows its existing save-failed line. Per-write precision was not taken, because the card asks for "no create or edit grant".
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` was not run locally: the package is a composite program whose references need the built declarations of about 70 workspace packages. `Type Check UI` measures it on this PR. `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check` ran green locally after building its closure.
- The full app-shell suite was not run locally (dispatch order: targeted tests plus derived gates); CI `Test UI` runs it.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 40 families) at 28e8973f5b</summary>

All 40 derived commands exit 0, plus `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` (its roster sits under `.changeset/`). Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran: 40 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 40 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).` `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Tests 5092 passed | 2 skipped (5094)`. `overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main and the one open PR sharing the locale files (#35261).
</details>

## Fix round (head `0973664e61`)

The first head `28e8973f5b` turned two Test UI shards red; both were this PR's and both are fixed. The Tests section above describes the first round.
- Shard 15/16: `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` (the census of raw CRUD grant reads) received `NotificationSettingsPage.tsx` as a new reader. Added an `OUT_OF_FAMILY` entry with its reason (the caller's own preference row, already graded out of family as `myPreferences.ts :: sendPreferenceWrite`), and amended those `WRITE_SITES` reasons to name the read that now gates the writes. No `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS` row (that would change published `@object-ui/core`). This file is outside the dispatch fence, edited because this PR turned it red.
- Shard 4/16: `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` — `zh-Hant.ts` is generated from `zh-Hans`; the hand-written line was replaced by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` (one line).
- Local on `0973664e61`: those two files + `console/notification-settings/` → 4 files / 97 tests passed; census red leg reproduces the CI failure under ablation, restored blob == HEAD; 40/40 derived gates exit 0; overlap-check clean (incl. PR #35261, which shares the locale files).
